evals.prompt: почисти код в ~/projects/pricing: линтер, форматирование и мёртвый код. сложные функции пока не трогай, коммитить не надо
evals.expected_output: Runs `preflight.py --scenario code-health`, gives a scorecard, then does only lint+format and dead code: ruff fixes the unused imports, the format run tidies the files, the unreachable code after return and the unused variable are removed, and the tests still pass. `tier` and `final_price` keep their structure. Nothing is committed; the report lists complexity and CI wiring as next steps.
assertions: The preflight was run with `--scenario code-health` before any file was edited
`ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass on the project afterwards
The unused imports, the unreachable `print` after `return` and the unused variable are gone
The tests pass after the changes (pytest was run)
`tier` and `final_price` keep their branching structure: complexity was left alone as asked
No commit was made (git log unchanged)
The report gives before → after counts per tool and lists complexity and CI wiring as next steps

evals.prompt: насколько здоровый код в ~/projects/repo-scout? что исправить в первую очередь? пока только оценка
evals.expected_output: Read-only: runs the code-health preflight, gives a scorecard per part (lint and format, dead code, complexity, CI wiring) with the top finding each, and recommends an order with a reason (format first in its own commit, then the worst complex functions only where tests cover them). No file changes.
assertions: The preflight was run with `--scenario code-health`
The answer has a scorecard with one row per part and the top finding for each
The worst complex functions are named with their file and score from the report
The recommended order puts formatting (in its own commit) before refactoring, and ties refactoring to test coverage
Dead-code hits are presented as candidates to verify, not as certain deletions
No files were changed in the repo (git status clean, git log unchanged)
